proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ s₁ s₂ h1 h2 hd
  have hd0 : s₂.radius - s₁.radius ≠ 0 := by linarith
  haveI : Nontrivial V := by
    refine ⟨⟨s₂.center -ᵥ s₁.center, 0, ?_⟩⟩
    intro h
    rw [vsub_eq_zero_iff_eq] at h
    rw [h, dist_self] at hd
    exact hd0 hd.symm
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.isIntTangent_iff_dist_center.mpr ⟨hd, h1.le, by linarith⟩
  have key : ∀ Q : P, Q ∈ s₁ → Q ∈ s₂ → (s₂.radius - s₁.radius) • (Q -ᵥ s₁.center) = s₁.radius • (s₁.center -ᵥ s₂.center) := by
    intro Q hQ1 hQ2
    have nx : ‖Q -ᵥ s₁.center‖ = s₁.radius := by rw [← dist_eq_norm_vsub V]; exact hQ1
    have ny : ‖s₁.center -ᵥ s₂.center‖ = s₂.radius - s₁.radius := by rw [← dist_eq_norm_vsub V]; exact hd
    have nz : ‖(Q -ᵥ s₁.center) + (s₁.center -ᵥ s₂.center)‖ = s₂.radius := by
      rw [vsub_add_vsub_cancel, ← dist_eq_norm_vsub V]; exact hQ2
    have hin : inner ℝ (Q -ᵥ s₁.center) (s₁.center -ᵥ s₂.center) = ‖Q -ᵥ s₁.center‖ * ‖s₁.center -ᵥ s₂.center‖ := by
      have h3 := norm_add_sq_real (Q -ᵥ s₁.center) (s₁.center -ᵥ s₂.center)
      rw [nz, ny, nx] at h3
      rw [ny, nx]
      linear_combination (-1 / 2) * h3
    have h4 := inner_eq_norm_mul_iff_real.mp hin
    rw [ny, nx] at h4
    exact h4
  refine ⟨T, ⟨hT.mem_left, hT.mem_right⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro Q ⟨hQ1, hQ2⟩
  have e := (key Q hQ1 hQ2).trans (key T hT.mem_left hT.mem_right).symm
  have := smul_right_injective V hd0 e
  exact vsub_left_injective _ this
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (s₁ s₂ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P), 0 < s₁.radius → s₁.radius < s₂.radius → dist s₁.center s₂.center = s₂.radius - s₁.radius → ∃! T : P, T ∈ s₁ ∧ T ∈ s₂
